question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay in an external ClawHub plugin?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes plugin ranking semantics, persistent FTS index behavior, config/default surface, and fallback policy for existing memory-lancedb users.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced LanceDB retrieval to ClawHub
options.body: Keep the official plugin focused on vector recall and point users who need BM25/reranking to an external LanceDB memory plugin.

options.title: Document vector-only scope
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and update docs so memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval while memory-lancedb is clearly a vector backend.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history and prior review-context signal for memory-lancedb product direction.
